facts.value: Study and research in the heart of Europe! As an international university with an excellent reputation, Goethe University offers a wide range of programs.
All important information about your path to us has been summarized: from admission requirements and applications to language skills.
The Global Office supports international exchange students and scholarship holders during their stay at Goethe University – from preparation to personal support on-site in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has gathered important information and services for international postdoctoral students, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial advice to a buddy program: Goethe University offers services regarding study applications, scholarships, residency rights, and much more - for a successful start in Frankfurt.
Discover our diverse study offerings for international students in Frankfurt - first-class teaching, exciting research, and a vibrant campus await you.
Need support for your career start? The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps you successfully transition from studying to working in the German job market.

Goethe University supports refugees before, during, and after their studies. In addition to preparatory courses and language courses, the offerings include scholarships, support with housing searches, official procedures, financing, and integration.
Discover the language offerings and opportunities for study preparation for foreign applicants at Goethe University.
